user_query: I'm organizing a family reunion and I need to send WhatsApp messages to all the attendees. Can you assist me in setting up a personal listener to receive their responses? Also, I would like to check if any of the attendees' phone numbers are registered on WhatsApp.

TaskList.description: Compile a list of all attendees' phone numbers to send WhatsApp messages.
Check each phone number from the attendee list to see if it is registered on WhatsApp.
Send WhatsApp messages to all attendees using the confirmed WhatsApp numbers.
Set up a listener to receive responses from attendees via WhatsApp.
